purpose: Frozen pre-implementation static audit supporting system_overhaul_plan.json. Original hashes/locations/counts are historical; current_source_status labels subsequent source drift. The living system map is the current inventory.

scope.scripts: Every GDScript file in the living system map, including retained tests, demos and fixtures.
scope.semantic_review: Method bodies cited by the plan were read separately. This inventory is syntax/fingerprint evidence, not proof that every function purpose or behavior has been validated.
scope.reachability: Literal preload/load reachability includes retained diagnostic scenes and is not proof of execution.
scope.counts: Inspection/snapshot names are candidate review sites, not proof of expensive reads, redundant work or bugs. Locations are distinct mapped expressions per function, not runtime frequencies. State literals/private-field matches are textual candidates requiring contextual review.
